story.title: Good Times Recap
story.setting: Bright, sunny, cheerful photo-memory look with warm natural light and gentle lively camera motion.

subjects.words: a happy golden retriever with its tongue out sitting on green park grass
a wide-eyed surprised tabby cat with its mouth open on a grey sofa
a smiling bearded man and a blonde woman taking a selfie on a sunny beach
a woman with dark curly hair in a grey knit sweater standing in a green park
a calm mountain lake at sunset with pine trees and pink-lit peaks reflected in the water

beats.text: The golden retriever pants happily, wags its tail and tilts its head toward the camera.
Quick push-in on the surprised cat as its eyes widen even more in shock.
The two friends laugh and lean their heads together for the selfie as waves roll in behind them.
The woman breaks into a big smile and her curls bounce slightly in the breeze.
Slow drone-like glide over the calm lake at sunset, ripples shimmering on the water.

story.music: upbeat, bouncy feel-good ukulele and hand-claps pop
